title: narcissus × tavaresii
intro: Narcissus × tavaresii, commonly known as Tazetta, is a hybrid flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to exhibit antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × tavaresii include its potential to reduce stress, improve mood, and alleviate symptoms associated with anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which is known for its potential to improve cognitive function and memory, and other compounds like saponins and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
